title: Fabricator

moves.title: Fabricate
effects: Spawn a Defensive Bot (Guardbot or Noisebot)
Spawn an Aggro Bot (Zapbot or Stabbot)

moves.title: Fabricating Strike
effects: Spawn an Aggro Bot (Zapbot or Stabbot)

move_pattern: While the Fabricator has fewer than 4 allies, it randomly alternates between Fabricate and Fabricating Strike. Once 4 allies are present, it only uses Disintegrate.
notes: FABRICATING_STRIKE_MOVE is hidden from the Bestiary. The Fabricator has a minion cap - it spawns minions (Zapbot, Stabbot, Guardbot, or Noisebot) until 4 allies are alive, then switches to pure damage with Disintegrate. Each spawned minion receives the Minion power.
